title: Mobile: Android
description: An Android device through the adb server on the host (port 5037); APK analysis in the workspace and with jadx as an MCP server.

de.title: Mobil: Android
de.description: Ein Android-Gerät über den adb-Server auf dem Host (Port 5037); APK-Analyse im Arbeitsordner und mit jadx als MCP-Server.

notes: Start the adb server on the host first: adb start-server. In the sandbox: adb -H 127.0.0.1 -P 5037 devices.
Podman only (pasta forwards the host's port).

jadx decompiles the APKs of the folder its server was added with (sandbox-ai mcp add mcp:jadx --mount /work=APKS:ro): classes, Java source, smali, cross references, the manifest and resources; no network, 2g memory (the catalog's limits).
